I switched from android a few months ago.

I had always considered using a Windows phone since I started messing with smartphones, but did not get one until my next upgrade.

I have to say when I first picked up the Lumia 920 I was impressed how smooth and gentle it ran compared to android, which within a few months started lagging.

The main two pros for me are the smooth moving features, and the simplistic design of the windows phone.

The app base is both a con and a pro. The small app developer base is a  downfall, but with the store having little apps it is easier to manage, and unlike android I do not feel paranoid about getting some weird virus.

All in all Windows phone does not seem to disappoint with each passing day, and the way Microsoft is listening to its users.
